description: Climate action arrives late after locked-in warming ecological stress and rising social vulnerability.
Coordinated mitigation adaptation public investment and governance reduce climate stress.
Wealthier regions adapt while exposed communities face underprotection and residual loss.
Technology accelerates decarbonization but justice governance and material constraints remain unresolved.
Earth-system feedbacks and ecological degradation accelerate beyond expected pathways.
Extreme events overwhelm institutions public finance infrastructure and emergency systems.
Decarbonization adaptation public finance ecological repair and justice reinforce one another.
Emissions fall but biodiversity water land labor and unequal vulnerability are poorly governed.
